title.zh: Copilot Studio 结合 Snowflake MCP Server 与 Cortex Agents 的三层受控数据架构（ODSP2233）
title.en: Three-Tier Governed AI Architecture with Copilot Studio, Snowflake MCP Server & Cortex Agents (ODSP2233)

label.zh: 1. 微软协同工作流与编排层（Microsoft 365 Teams · Copilot Studio · Microsoft Foundry）
label.en: 1. Microsoft Workplace & Agent Orchestration Layer (M365 Teams · Copilot Studio · Foundry)

label.zh: 2. 协议与身份治理桥接层（Snowflake MCP Server · Entra External OAuth · Cortex Agents）
label.en: 2. Protocol & Identity Governance Bridge (Snowflake MCP Server · OAuth · Cortex Agents)

label.zh: 3. Snowflake AI Data Cloud 双模推理与数据层（Cortex Analyst 语义视图 · Cortex Search 非结构化）
label.en: 3. Snowflake AI Data Cloud Dual-Modal Reasoning Layer (Cortex Analyst & Cortex Search)

label.zh: M365 Teams 与业务前端渠道

detail.zh: 非技术业务人员在日常聊天流中用自然语言直询库存、运营与客户动态
detail.en: Non-technical teams query inventory, ops & sales facts in plain language

label.zh: Microsoft Copilot Studio 编排中枢

detail.zh: 融合低代码拖拽与 YAML 代码模型（Skills for Copilot Studio），统筹跨源工作流
detail.en: Blends low-code UI & YAML skills to orchestrate M365 and Snowflake tools

detail.zh: 为复杂智能体提供前沿模型底座，并支持在 Snowflake Cortex 内直接调用
detail.en: Supplies frontier models for pro-code agents & direct Cortex model inference

label.zh: Entra External OAuth / SSO 与角色授权

detail.zh: 执行 OAuth 令牌透传与 GRANT USAGE ON MCP SERVER 最小角色隔离
detail.en: Enforces OAuth token passthrough & Snowflake role-scoped server grants

detail.zh: 通过 CREATE MCP SERVER 将 CORTEX_AGENT_RUN 标准化暴露为协议工具
detail.en: Exposes sales_intelligence_agent (CORTEX_AGENT_RUN) as a standard MCP tool

label.zh: Snowflake Cortex Agent 智能路由

detail.zh: 由 Cortex Code 辅助构建，自主裁决调用结构化指标分析或非结构化对话检索
detail.en: Built with Cortex Code to broker structured SQL vs. unstructured text search

detail.zh: 基于 sales_metrics_model.yaml 语义视图生成精准 SQL，零手工写表关联
detail.en: Uses sales_metrics_model.yaml semantic views to generate governed SQL

label.zh: Cortex Search（非结构化通话检索）

detail.zh: 检索 SALES_CONVERSATION_SEARCH 通话纪要，提炼关键要点与待办行动项
detail.en: Indexes SALES_CONVERSATION_SEARCH transcripts for call summaries & actions

label.zh: Horizon Catalog 治理与冷链 IoT 数仓

detail.zh: 汇聚多仓 WMS、RFID 与 IoT 实时数据，全链路不绕过 Snowflake 原生安全边界
detail.en: Unifies multi-WMS, RFID & IoT telemetry under native Snowflake security

label.zh: 行级安全与单一事实源
